5672.title: Resumed child lifecycles lose delegation correlation
5672.rootCauseOneLine: Completed-child cleanup removes active delegation links; an early resumed-child start ignores retained child identity, and a later activity does not rebind that turn to the new delegation.

prReviews.topFinding: Translator changes cover both identity fallback and turn-map rebinding; unrelated bundled changes were not evaluated.

5672.proposedFix: Fall back to retained distinct-child identity and rebind started turns when the replacement delegation arrives.
5672.caveats: Repeated translator-level reproduction; exact production steering incident and real provider event timing were not accessed or replayed. Repro patch and output are inline under the public report repository's artifact policy.
